shape: an ordinary object that turns out to hold a whole memory

slides.text: i pulled the yellow tape measure out of the kitchen drawer yesterday, just to see how far it would stretch.
when i was small, my only job was holding the metal hook flat against the wall.
i thought we were building something important, because you checked the pencil mark on the wood twice.
but you were only putting up a crooked shelf for the shoes by the back door.
so when i moved into my own place, i bought the exact same heavy yellow one.
i hooked the end against the wall this morning to see if a desk would fit.
but the metal snapped back across the room, because nobody was kneeling there to hold it down.
[[thank you for pretending]] you needed two people to measure a piece of wood.

caption:
he let me hold the heavy end anyway, just to keep me in the room.
send this to your dad if he still has a jar of mixed screws on his workbench.

alt: a story about remembering helping your dad measure things with a tape measure when you were little.
